findings: BLOCKING: numerical inference violates explicit user rule. Remove ALL unsupported volumes, dimensions, lumen ratings, R values, water-column ratings, training schedules/weights, hydration liters, rope lengths, UV percentages, wind speeds and temperature ranges from every answer field. last_verified plus a generic official homepage is not evidence for these figures.

BLOCKING SAFETY: N95 does not protect against volcanic gases; sulfur smell is not a trigger for treating an ash mask as sufficient protection. neck_gaiter promises ash/respiratory protection from ordinary fabric; remove. Ash response belongs weather_volcano; coordinate supported guidance rather than improvised treatment.

BLOCKING SAFETY: thermal_flask claims warm liquids raise core temperature/instant restoration and cold water wastes valuable energy. Remove unproven physiology and therapeutic guarantees. rubber_boots invents mandatory orthopedic insoles and wool socks; remove false requirement.

fitness_training invents exact 4–8 week plan, 45 minute sessions, 5–8 kg loads, 3-day rest and twice cardiovascular effort at 4000 m. Replace with source-supported broad fitness advice; do not prescribe training or imply fitness prevents altitude illness.

Evidence file pnn_preparation_guidelines.txt is a synthesized guideline, not an original fetched page with specific quotations. Audit each claimed consulted source against actual retrieval history. Preserve real raw documents/extracts with exact URL, dates and supporting quotes; mark unvisited URLs as unverified and remove their attribution.

One source allegedly mandates Vibram soles, specific layers, 150–300 lumens and branded fabrics without direct evidence. Avoid product brands, blanket mandatory wording and technical gear unsupported by sources.

Scope: pre_trip_acclimatization belongs health_safety; ash response belongs weather_volcano; prohibited_single_use_plastics/prohibited_speakers_drones/prohibited_alcohol_fire as rules belong rules. What-not-to-pack checklist can reference verified rules without cloning their intents.

Camp hygiene recommends digging catholes with dimensions without park-specific environmental authorization. Remove this instruction unless explicit park rule supports it; direct visitors to authorized sanitary practice/guide without inventing methods.

ALL short/variants/detail/steps/reflection fields require review, not only five samples. Remove unsourced medical, gear-performance and behavioral guarantees, shorten verbose advice. It is preferable to deliver substantially fewer than 60 entries with genuine support.
